messages:
maya: heads-up: nvme write latency spike + a small cluster of CRCs in us-west2. GPUs are stuck in provisioning queue, backlog ~24 GPUs :grimacing:
ops-bot: [ALERT] metric=nvme_write_latency region=us-west2 nodes=gnode-uw2-{201..207} current=36ms threshold=25ms
sam: any firmware churn? or is this churned by big delete waves from the cleaner?
maya: dmesg shows repeated nvme0 I/O CRC errors and a surge of rm -rf style deletes from the ephemeral-cleaner at 02:37 UTC. cleaner started a large sweep (no canary)
ivan: OOF. let's avoid a full pause. proposal: (1) split the cohort into staggered windows, (2) reduce parallel deletes per node, (3) enable a "critical-ops" semaphore so attach paths preempt cleaner while backlog > X
zoe: agree on semaphore. also add a temporary local retention bump for recently-used tempdirs to reduce churn during recovery (e.g., 10m -> 60m)
paul: cost note: stalled attaches = idle GPUs. Ballpark: 24 gpus * 45m => 1080 gpu-minutes. tagging finance later for exact $ impact
sam: quick mitigation rolled: CLEANER_PARALLEL=2 and DELETE_CHUNK=256MB on the us-west2 daemonset. rolling to 7 nodes now. also added cleaner.flag=yield_to_attach=true
maya: command used:
```
kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/ephemeral-cleaner CLEANER_PARALLEL=2 --context=us-west2
kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/ephemeral-cleaner DELETE_CHUNK_BYTES=268435456 --context=us-west2
kubectl -n infra patch daemonset/ephemeral-cleaner -n infra --type='json' -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/metadata/annotations/cleaner.flag","value":"yield_to_attach=true"}]' --context=us-west2
```
ops-bot: [METRIC] us-west2 nvme_write_latency 1m=28ms 5m=30ms 15m=16ms
ivan: good. curious about wear pattern: QA run shows this cohort has elevated program/erase cycles compared to baseline. filing an extra check with hw-telemetry to rule out a failing flash channel
zoe: follow-up: we'll stagger future cleaner runs by node-ordinal (mod 6 windows) and add a 10% jitter to schedule so waves don't collide after rolling restarts
paul: decision: avoid cross-region rebalancing for now. if write latency doesn't drop below 25ms within 90m we will consider moving non-critical jobs to eu-west1 for 2-3h. ping me for approval
maya: current status: attach backlog down to 9, 1m nvme write latency 21ms. opening ticket INFRA-4412 "staggered-cleaner + attach-preempt" assigned to eng-infra. owners: zoe (scheduler), sam (rollback/playbook), maya (monitoring)
sam: playbook snippets to include in ticket: how to throttle, how to add the yield flag, and an automated rollback if CRCs increase after change
ivan: note to self: query hw-telemetry for block error rate delta for cohort over past 7d and attach to INFRA-4412
zoe: will implement staggered cron windows and add canary flag for next deploy. also proposing a small permanent default: DELETE_CHUNK_BYTES=256MB and CLEANER_PARALLEL=3 for hot cohorts
maya: thanks. monitoring for 60m then will close thread unless regression :thumbsup:
